goal: Add a one-time imm-kernel migrate --to-vNext [--check] command that flattens historical .imm/audit/ TaskRecord v2/v3/v4 evidence (and any residual verification_descriptor v1-shaped payload) into pure v4-shaped JSON via the existing verified-import-then-atomic-publish pattern, writes a distinct receipt and schema marker, and adds a startup gate on this version refusing to run against a workspace missing that marker.

acceptance.assertion: migrate --to-vNext refuses to run with an active Kernel claim or unsettled unattended batch present; --check diagnoses preconditions and record inventory without publishing; a real run flattens historical .imm/audit/ evidence to pure v4-shaped JSON, verifies its identity digest before publish, and writes a receipt distinct from the storage-layout migration's own.
The existing --storage-layout migration's own receipt, marker, and behavior are completely unaffected by the new --to-vNext migration's presence.
Kernel startup refuses to operate on a workspace missing the vNext marker, naming imm-kernel migrate --to-vNext as the recovery action, and proceeds normally once the marker is present.
